name: hourglass
description: KOZMOS Hourglass: the limit oracle. For the 5-hour, weekly and spend windows: percent used, reset countdown, a burn rate learned across sessions, the time to 100 % and a verdict on whether the reset comes first. Toasts at 80 % and 95 %, an optional status line. /hourglass toggles the sidebar.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Hourglass sidebar when a session starts (where the layout docks panes).

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Pin a short limits line under the prompt, such as: 5h 42% · 7d 18%.
